text: Pipeline segment P-14 pressure transmitter housing: please box every corrosion blister and loose flange bolt visible in the inspection photos, with coordinates for each. 所有图像数据只能在本站处理，不得传出厂区。精度用常规模型就够了，不需要额外调优。
